card.name: Inside chemical and brand names
card.fires_on: Short endings partway through a longer chemical or brand name, such as 'ole' in polyolefin, aminolevulinate and linoleum, 'ol' in esmolol, and 'ROL' in NICOTROL. Also 'les' in arterioles.

modes.label: ole inside chemical words
modes.description: The piece 'ole' or 'les' sits in the middle of a chemical or anatomical term.

modes.label: Ending of drug brand names
modes.description: A closing piece of a drug name such as -ol or -ROL, followed by a form or salt word.

card.plain: It fires on a short piece inside a long chemical or drug name, as the word is still being spelled out.
